name: Tailscale
content:
Tailscale is proud to be a fully remote company with team members in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and Singapore. We recognize an inclusive workplace starts with a team that is not bound by geographical location, lifestyle, or life stage. No matter where you choose to work, you’ll be supported and empowered to do your best work. 

At Tailscale, we’re building the new Internet. Our mission is to remove the overhead and complexity from the “long tail” of software and operational problems that people face every day. We’re searching for smart, passionate people who see the world differently, who aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo and work as a team to solve challenges together.  

Are you ready to be part of the change? Check out our current openings below to apply!
